title: Use ChatGPT to draft the video structure and character settings, generate…
content: Use ChatGPT to draft the video structure and character settings, generate character images from those descriptions, then feed the images into TapNow to generate the video quickly.
tips: Use ChatGPT to draft the video structure and character settings, generate character images from those descriptions, then feed the images into TapNow to generate the video quickly.

en.content: Use ChatGPT to draft the video structure and character settings, generate character images from those descriptions, then feed the images into TapNow to generate the video quickly.

es.content: Usa ChatGPT para redactar la estructura del video y la configuración de los personajes, genera imágenes de los personajes a partir de esas descripciones, luego introduce las imágenes en TapNow para generar el video rápidamente.

fr.content: Utilisez ChatGPT pour rédiger la structure de la vidéo et les paramètres des personnages, générez des images de personnages à partir de ces descriptions, puis intégrez les images dans TapNow pour générer rapidement la vidéo.

ko.content: ChatGPT를 사용하여 비디오 구조와 캐릭터 설정을 초안으로 작성하고, 그 설명을 바탕으로 캐릭터 이미지를 생성한 후, TapNow에 이미지를 입력하여 비디오를 빠르게 생성하세요.

pt.content: Use o ChatGPT para elaborar a estrutura do vídeo e as configurações dos personagens, gerar imagens dos personagens a partir dessas descrições e, em seguida, inserir as imagens no TapNow para gerar o vídeo rapidamente.

zh.content: 使用ChatGPT起草视频结构和角色设置，根据这些描述生成角色图像，然后将图像输入TapNow快速生成视频。
